research_notes: Initial research 1 October 2026: frozen parliamentary occupations and indexed official biography, first speech, employer ownership history, publisher author/event records, contemporary ABC coverage and historical student sources reviewed.

University of Adelaide Bachelor of Social Sciences and reported postgraduate law study are education, not paid employment. Study dates or parenting do not prove part-time work or leave; no such inference made.

Qualifying private banking and freelance work exist but substantive full-time status, dates and overlaps are unresolved. The market role has unidentified employer/control. No defensible zero for either sector.

Searches targeted Amnesty historical annual reports, full-time/part-time work, market employer, student presidency remuneration and professional profile. No applicable working-hours evidence found. Vacancy advertisements for her parliamentary employees do not describe her own earlier work.

Public LinkedIn profile https://au.linkedin.com/in/sarah-hanson-young-7023263 identified, but open returned (999) Unknown Status Code; no authentication or access-control workaround. APH direct biography returned Internal Error; indexed and frozen facts retained. MUP old book link returned Page Not Found; publisher event provides independent book evidence.

Justice for Refugees campaigning appears in derivative biographies; paid status, dates and primary corroboration not established. Retain as follow-up lead rather than paid employment. University On Dit archive and parliamentary witness listing may lead to student association annual accounts/stipend evidence.

Next follow-up: actual Central Markets employer; BankSA dates/hours and payroll entity; Amnesty leave/fraction/exit; Parnell campaign contract dates/payroll; student association stipends; freelance clients, paid periods and overlaps. Preserve year precision and do not sum overlapping roles.

Follow-up2026-10-02: official Party Positions entry adds2006communications/media officer role, keeping possible duplication with Parnell assignment explicit. Targeted searches for Central Markets stall/employer, BankSA hours and Amnesty part-time/leave records found no applicable evidence.

Contemporary2006Australian candidate profile and CPA Guardian refugee report located through reference trails; both direct opens returned InternalError. Derivative copies are not independent confirmation of2006Parnell employment dates or paid Justice for Refugees work. No inaccessible text used. Student-archive, Amnesty annual-report and freelance-contract gaps remain for later follow-up.

Follow-up2026-10-03: exact-name CentralMarket, BankSA, Parnell and Amnesty searches returned the existing parliamentary chronology, ABC retrospective and derivative repetitions. The official biography still identifies a workplace rather than the market stall/employing entity, and no payroll, hours or leave record surfaced. Derivative2006campaign descriptions were not promoted into exact contract dates; no new source or interval added.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Located contemporaneous2009Greens magazine confirming a four-year Amnesty SA/NT campaign-manager period, corroborating the existing2004–2008range. This is additional corroboration rather than a new interval or hours finding. On Dit May2003 index again identifies her student presidency but supplies no stipend/contract. Justice for Refugees campaigning remains a secondary lead without primary pre-parliament role, remuneration or dates. Market employer, BankSA hours, Amnesty/party overlaps and freelance contracts remain unknown.

Follow-up2026-10-05: publisher record identifies The Monthly as a named writing outlet with17November2015 contribution, added within existing freelance spell; fees/hours unknown and publication date not imposed as payroll tenure. Direct article reader failed but public indexed publisher text supplied byline/date. MUP author page corroborates authorship without contract information. Targeted market-stall, BankSA, Amnesty maternity/leave and2007freelance searches did not resolve earlier hours/employer gaps. ALGA2010profile reproduction supplies existing chronology, not payment/leave evidence; parenting/preselection stories do not establish maternity leave from Amnesty. Retain unresolved totals.
